reason: Seven hundred dollars a month is real money when fuel, insurance and wages are already eating the margin, and I'm not putting every booking, customer and driver record into a brand-new outfit with no customers. If they fold in the middle of excursion season, I'm the one left stranded.
objection: Is this a new company that could disappear and take my bookings and driver records with it, right when I can least afford the disruption?
would_change_my_mind: A few other coach operators my size actually running on it, plus a written guarantee I can export all my data any time, and a free trial outside the busy season.
